mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, phone_number_id, waba_id, business_name, access_token_enc, webhook_verify_token_enc, app_secret_enc, webhook_configured, last_error, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM crm_whatsapp_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, phone_number_id, waba_id, business_name, access_token_enc, webhook_verify_token_enc, app_secret_enc, webhook_configured, last_error, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM crm_whatsapp_config WHERE phone_number_id = #{phoneNumberId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_whatsapp_config ( tenant_id, phone_number_id, waba_id, business_name, access_token_enc, webhook_verify_token_enc, app_secret_enc, webhook_configured, last_error, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{phoneNumberId}, #{wabaId}, #{businessName}, #{accessTokenEnc}, #{webhookVerifyTokenEnc}, #{appSecretEnc}, #{webhookConfigured}, #{lastError}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET phone_number_id = EXCLUDED.phone_number_id, waba_id = EXCLUDED.waba_id, business_name = EXCLUDED.business_name, access_token_enc = EXCLUDED.access_token_enc, webhook_verify_token_enc = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.webhook_verify_token_enc, crm_whatsapp_config.webhook_verify_token_enc), app_secret_enc = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.app_secret_enc, crm_whatsapp_config.app_secret_enc), webhook_configured = EXCLUDED.webhook_configured, last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error, update_by = EXCLUDED.update_by, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
